reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn rank_compress(s:&str)->Option<String>{let a=nums(s)?;let u:std::collections::BTreeSet<_>=a.iter().copied().collect();let r:std::collections::HashMap<_,_>=u.into_iter().enumerate().map(|(i,x)|(x,i)).collect();Some(a.into_iter().map(|x|r[&x].to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}
